title: ophrys × arachnitiformis subsp. marzuola
intro: Ophrys × arachnitiformis subsp. marzuola, commonly known as Marzuola Spider Orchid, is a hybrid orchid species that belongs to the Ophrys genus. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Marzuola Spider Orchid include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and aiding in wound healing, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. Further research is needed to fully understand the bioactive constituents and therapeutic effects of this plant.
